messages.subject: Re: RHIPE simple Example ...error
messages.body_plain:
rhmr() was depreciated and then removed.  Use rhwatch() instead.  It is rhmr() with more functionality and more organized monitoring of MapReduce jobs.  It basically starts and watches jobs for you.
